resources.string: Creates a VPN connection that routes no traffic. The session name you enter is what appears next to "Connected to" in system notifications and dialogs.
This app is set as Always-On VPN, so the system restarts it immediately after disconnecting. Open Settings → Network & internet → VPN, and turn off Always-On for DoNothingVPN, then disconnect again.

The system did not show a VPN confirmation window. This is usually caused by one of the following:

1. Another VPN (or an Always-On VPN) is active — open Settings → Network & internet → VPN and disconnect or remove it.
2. This app is blocked from showing pop-up windows — open Settings → Apps → DoNothingVPN → background pop-up windows and allow it.

After making these changes, tap Connect again.
Failed to start VPN. Check logcat.
VPN configuration is restricted by a device policy on this device, so the system cannot show the confirmation dialog. Please contact your device administrator.
Enter a new app name first.
That is already the current app name.
